description: Shared CI/CD pipeline scenarios. Every agent receives the same scenario dictionary (a deep copy) so their decisions can be compared fairly. Data is simulated for demonstration; it is not taken from a real pipeline.

scenarios.name: Unit Test Failure After Code Change
scenarios.description: A developer modified payment validation logic. The build succeeds but two unit tests fail.
scenarios.build_logs:
[build] Installing dependencies from requirements.txt ... done
[build] Compiling payments-service ... done
[build] Build completed successfully in 48s
[test] Running 20 tests with pytest
[test] FAILED tests/test_validator.py::test_rejects_expired_card - AssertionError: expected ValidationError, got None
[test] FAILED tests/test_validator.py::test_amount_upper_limit - AssertionError: assert 200 == 422
[test] 18 passed, 2 failed in 6.3s
[pipeline] Stage 'tests' failed; deployment skipped

dependencies.notes: No dependency changes in this run.

recent_changes: Commit a1f3c9e: Modified validate_payment() in payments/validator.py (expiry and amount checks refactored)

expected.rationale: Build passed, tests failed, and the failing tests target the recently modified validate_payment() function.

scenarios.name: Dependency Version Unavailable / Incompatible
scenarios.description: requirements.txt was updated to a library version that does not exist on the package index, so the build cannot resolve dependencies.
scenarios.build_logs:
[build] Installing dependencies from requirements.txt
[build] Collecting requests==2.31.0 ... ok
[build] Collecting pydantic==3.9.1
[build] ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement pydantic==3.9.1 (from versions: 1.10.13, 2.5.3, 2.7.4)
[build] ERROR: No matching distribution found for pydantic==3.9.1
[build] Build failed: dependency resolution error (exit code 1)
[pipeline] Stage 'build' failed; tests and deployment skipped

test_results.notes: Tests did not run because the build failed.

dependencies.notes: pydantic 3.9.1 is not published on the configured package index.

recent_changes: Commit c42e8b1: Bumped pydantic from 2.7.4 to 3.9.1 in requirements.txt

expected.rationale: Build failed at dependency resolution immediately after the pydantic version bump.

scenarios.name: Deployment Health Check Failure After Release
scenarios.description: Build and tests pass and the release is deployed, but the service fails its readiness health checks.
scenarios.build_logs:
[build] Build completed successfully in 52s
[test] 64 passed in 11.2s
[deploy] Deploying inventory-service v1.8.0 to staging
[deploy] Rolling update started (3 replicas)
[deploy] Readiness probe failed: GET /health returned 503 (attempt 1/5)
[deploy] Readiness probe failed: GET /health returned 503 (attempt 5/5)
[deploy] Deployment health check failed; release marked unhealthy

dependencies.notes: No dependency changes in this run.

recent_changes: Commit 9f0b7c2: Renamed environment variable DB_URL to DATABASE_URL in config/settings.py

health_checks.message: Service Unavailable: database connection not configured

scenarios.deployment_logs:
[app] Starting inventory-service v1.8.0
[app] ERROR: KeyError: 'DATABASE_URL' environment variable not set
[app] Health endpoint reporting 503: database connection not configured

expected.rationale: Build and tests passed; health checks return 503 and runtime logs show a missing environment variable after a config rename.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous: Test Stage Timed Out With Incomplete Logs
scenarios.description: The test stage timed out. Logs are truncated, no test report was produced and the recent-change summary is unavailable. The failure type cannot be determined with confidence.
scenarios.build_logs:
[build] Build completed successfully in 40s
[test] Running test suite ...
[test] ... (log truncated: runner lost connection after 30m)
[pipeline] Stage 'tests' exceeded time limit

test_results.notes: No test report produced (runner timed out).

expected.rationale: Evidence is incomplete; a good agent should avoid over-confident classification and ask for more diagnostics (e.g. full logs, test report, rerun with verbose output).

scenarios.name: Normal: Healthy Pipeline (Control Case)
scenarios.description: All stages pass and health checks succeed. Used as a control to confirm agents do not invent failures.
scenarios.build_logs:
